clue.text: Back copies marked and sorted out

explanation.surface: A back-issues clerk has graded the old copies and filed them away.

explanation.definitionFit: Things sorted out have been divided into groups, kept apart from one another.

clue.text: Old table top found amongst discounted items

parts.note: goods on sale are those offered at reduced prices

indicators.note: the top of the word table is its opening letter

clue.text: Drug dropped in normal place for someone not yet accepted

explanation.surface: A dealer has left drugs in an ordinary spot for a newcomer.
explanation.definitionFit: A parvenu is an upstart newly risen in society whose status the established set has not yet acknowledged.

clue.text: Cook a sort of dish

definitions.meaning: to cook meat in the oven by dry heat
a joint of meat cooked in the oven, served as a meal

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the oven-cooking method and the meat joint produced by it, as in a Sunday dinner.

clue.text: Muck found on a prophet turning up in overalls

clue.text: Solid 19 scored by youngster at end of race

explanation.definitionFit: A cube is the solid with six equal faces, the three-dimensional counterpart of a square.

clue.text: Bloody chamber vacated by setter's relative

clue.text: Ale-drinking achievement by English yeoman

clue.text: Transport for Conservative replacing miners' leader in union

explanation.definitionFit: A carriage is a vehicle, a means of conveyance such as a horse-drawn coach or railway car.

clue.text: Caught church official about to snort a line

clue.text: Leave last of apples out of pudding

indicators.note: the last of apples is its final letter

clue.text: Research covering fine new creative work about to change

the research abbreviation covers, i.e. wraps around, another piece

clue.text: Check soldiers with impressive muscles

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
buff is slang for muscular and toned

clue.text: Space on island found during time of stress

clue.text: European eating almost half of elusive meal

clue.text: Tiny tree developed for a very long time

indicators.note: developed means the letters are worked into something new

clue.text: Clean clothes taken back to the French ship

indicators.note: taken back means the clothes word is read in reverse

le is French for the (masculine)

explanation.definitionFit: Spotless means without any mark or stain, perfectly clean.

clue.text: Quite small child getting supporter

an ally supports one's cause

explanation.definitionFit: Quite in its sense of completely or wholly, as in 'quite right'.

clue.text: Conservative's "question and answer" tour's ending in the Home Counties

clue.text: Vessel containing coin exchanged for fabulous creature

indicators.note: exchanged means the letters of coin are swapped around

explanation.definitionFit: The unicorn is a creature of fable, a horse with a single horn.

clue.text: Sticky stuff coating sickly sweet

clue.text: Lecturer entering fine faculty

parts.note: fair weather is fine weather

clue.text: Instrument for changing oil into French wine

indicators.note: into places the rearranged letters inside the wine word

parts.note: vin is French for wine

indicators.note: changing reorders the letters of oil

clue.text: Experienced soprano helped to carry Oberon's wings
